# AI Elements — build AI chat UIs with shadcn-based React components

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills's ai-elements skill, listed here with credit to its creator: a setup and usage guide for AI Elements, the shadcn/ui-based component library for AI-native applications (conversations, messages, tool displays, prompt inputs and more). It covers prerequisites (Node 18+, Next.js, AI SDK, shadcn/ui), installing components via the AI Elements CLI into your own codebase (`components/ai-elements/`, full source ownership), usage patterns with `useChat` from the AI SDK, extensibility (all primitives extend standard HTML attributes), and troubleshooting (unstyled components, CLI no-ops, theme switching, missing module imports, tsconfig aliases). Overlap note: @jackspace's ai-elements-chatbot listing in this same lot covers the same underlying library from a production-chatbot-recipe angle — this skill is the general setup and component guide. Honest caveats: needs an existing Next.js + shadcn/ui project; the skill recommends the Vercel AI Gateway for model access (free $5/mo usage tier); the library targets React/Next.js only. Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
